pool.text: Founding of Arequida as Villa Hermosa de Nuestra Señora de la Asunta
Plan of 49 blocks or islands laid out for the city foundation.
Arequipa elevated to city status by royal decree
Earthquake promoted sillar as preferred building material in architecture.
Received the title "Most Faithful" from Charles IV
City council granted the address "Most Excellent"
First radio tests conducted in Arequipa, pioneering broadcasting.
Luis Sánchez Cerro seized power in Arequipa
Radio Landa became the first official regional radio station.
José María Morante Archaeological Museum opened in historic building.
Municipality opened maternal nursery and created office to control street begging.
Rodríguez Ballón International Airport opened
Concept of Ciudad Universitaria de Independencia designed by Héctor Velarde.
Francisco Mostajo led a revolution against Odría
Earthquake accelerated migration and urbanization
Earthquake accelerated peripheral urban growth and relocation of institutions.
Television inaugurated in Cultural Pavilion of National University of San Agustín.
Second major earthquake further shaped urban expansion patterns.
First decentralized TV signal broadcast by Radio Televisión Continental (channel 6).
Picanterías recognized as Cultural Heritage of the Nation.
